client_import_help_html:
This template lets you add several new clients at once instead of one at a time. Download it, fill in a row for each new client below the two example rows (then delete the examples), and upload it back here.

Required for every row

  • Full Name (EN) and Full Name (AR) — the client's name in both languages.
  • Phone — include the country code, e.g. +971501234567.
  • Country — pick a value from the dropdown in that column.
  • Interest Type — "Sale" or "Rent" only (from the dropdown).
  • Assigned Employee — pick the agent responsible for this client from the dropdown.

Optional

  • Marketing Channel — pick from the dropdown if it applies, or type a new one.
owner_import_help_html:
This template lets you add several new owners at once instead of one at a time. Download it, fill in a row for each new owner below the two example rows (then delete the examples), and upload it back here.

Required for every row

  • Full Name (EN) and Full Name (AR) — the owner's name in both languages.
  • Phone — include the country code, e.g. +971501234567.
  • Country — pick a value from the dropdown in that column.

Optional

  • Assigned Employee — pick the agent responsible for this owner from the dropdown. Leave blank if not decided yet.
  • Marketing Channel — pick from the dropdown if it applies, or type a new one.
  • Linked Property Code(s) — to connect this owner to properties that already exist in the system: pick the first code from the dropdown (a shortcut to avoid typos), then keep typing the rest of the codes after it, separated by commas — the cell won't reject that extra typing, since the dropdown is a helper, not a hard restriction (a single Excel cell can only offer one pick from the list itself, but you can still edit it manually afterward). Leave blank if the owner has no registered properties yet — you can always link one later from the property's own page.

bayut_portal_help_html:
Turning this switch on and publishing a property here only gets your listing ready inside Mandera CRM. It does not send anything to Bayut or Dubizzle by itself. Bayut and Dubizzle check the link above on their own schedule and automatically collect whichever listings are marked as published at that time.

Steps to go live on Bayut & Dubizzle

  1. Turn this switch on, then publish at least one property from that property's own page.
  2. Copy the link above.
  3. Log in to your company's own Bayut/Dubizzle partner account and paste this link wherever they ask you to add your listings feed. Open Bayut partner login ↗
  4. From then on, Bayut and Dubizzle will visit this link by themselves — usually within a day — and add your published listings automatically. No further action is needed from you.
bayut_portal_help_hint_html:
About the "Regenerate Feed URL" button

This button replaces your link with a brand-new one and stops the old one from working immediately. Only use it if you think the old link may have been seen by someone it shouldn't have, or right before you give the link to Bayut/Dubizzle for the very first time. If you already gave the old link to Bayut or Dubizzle, you must log in there and update it with the new one — otherwise your listings will stop appearing.
pf_portal_help_html:
PropertyFinder works differently from Bayut and Dubizzle: it is instant. The moment this is switched on and a listing is published here, it appears live on PropertyFinder's website right away — there is no waiting.

API Key and API Secret

These two codes belong to your company's own PropertyFinder account — they are not something we can generate for you. If your company does not have a PropertyFinder account yet, PropertyFinder needs to set one up for you first. How to get connected with PropertyFinder ↗

Listing Agent

This tells PropertyFinder which agent your listings appear under on their website. Once the API key and secret above are saved, the agent list is loaded straight from your PropertyFinder account — just pick the name. If an agent is missing from the list, add them on PropertyFinder first. If the list does not load at all, contact integration.support@propertyfinder.ae

License Number

PropertyFinder does not issue this number at all. It is your company's official real estate brokerage license, issued by the government body responsible for real estate in your emirate — for example RERA in Dubai or ADREC in Abu Dhabi. Your company already has this number on its trade license. It is a digits-only number (for example 20250000615558) — not the CN-… licence that belongs to an individual agent, and not the per-listing permit you enter on each property.

Before switching this on — confirm this account is really yours

A key being accepted by our system only means it is a valid, active key — not that it belongs to your company. Before publishing anything real, contact PropertyFinder and confirm the account details match your company's name and agents. Publishing a listing under another company's real estate license is a serious legal problem, not just a technical mistake.
